title: FR → Compliance Mapping
description: Agent-authored artifact connecting project FRs to compliance framework rows. Lives alongside the FR catalogue as a separate file (default: fr-compliance-mapping.json). Each entry maps one compliance row to one or more FR IDs, with rationale + confidence for human review.

catalogue_path.description: Path to the FR catalogue this mapping is for. Relative to the project root.

appropriate.description: Whether this compliance row applies to the project. When false, the row shows as 'N/A' in the compliance matrix with the rationale explaining why.

satisfied_by.description: FR IDs whose capabilities address this compliance row. Empty when appropriate is false.

test_refs.description: Optional: per-FR test IDs that are relevant to this specific compliance row. Keys are FR IDs, values are arrays of test IDs. When absent, all tests on the referenced FRs are assumed relevant.

rationale.description: Why the mapping is (or isn't) appropriate. For appropriate rows: why the cited FRs address this row. For inappropriate rows: why it doesn't apply. Shown in the UI for human review.

confidence.description: Agent's self-assessment. 'low' or 'medium' flag rows the user should review carefully.
